title: CYPHER LOG
description: A floating, book-like journal library for Cypher System worlds. Integrates with Cypher GM Taskbar and Cypher Taskbar — when either module is active, the Cypher Log button automatically moves into the Taskbar instead of floating standalone.

optional.reason: When active, the Cypher Log launcher button is automatically moved into the GM Taskbar instead of floating standalone.
When active, the Cypher Log launcher button is automatically moved into the player Taskbar (right of the portrait eye button) instead of floating standalone.
